responsibility: This implementation module supplies the native-host backend for the gm2 coroutine SYSTEM interface. It bridges Modula-2 PROCESS operations to lower runtime services in RTco and RTint by initializing thread support, creating coroutine contexts, switching between them, attaching interrupt vectors for IOTRANSFER, listening for I/O or timer events, and changing interrupt protection levels; it also implements the runtime support functions ShiftVal/ShiftLeft/ShiftRight and RotateVal/RotateLeft/RotateRight that manipulate multiword BITSET values when the compiler cannot inline those operations.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the native-host implementation of the SYSTEM interface declared in SYSTEM.def: it connects PROCESS operations to RTco and RTint services, installs I/O transfer handlers, performs actual context switching and interrupt listening, and implements the multiword BITSET shift/rotate helper routines rather than merely declaring them.
